_comment: Rubix stress E2E configuration. Override via --config flag or --small-test for quick validation.
_comment_buffer: min_balance_buffer reserves RBT that the shuttle phase will NOT spend, so the later asset phases (NFT/SC/FT/bundled/all-in-one/intra-node) have funds. Must exceed the asset phases' total RBT need (~50) or those phases starve even when plenty was minted.
_comment_small: small_test: sized so the FULL --run-all-tests matrix completes every transaction (used by CI). It's localnet, so minting is free/instant — we mint generously (nodeA 500, quorum 1000) rather than risk starvation. Index ranges are kept far apart (nodeA 300000+, quorum 400000+; 100k gap) so token-number ranges can never overlap across nodes. A shuttle min_balance_buffer reserves RBT so the shuttle phase doesn't drain nodeA before the NFT/SC/FT/bundled/all-in-one/intra-node phases run.
_comment_micro: micro_test: minimal budget for fast RBT-chain tracing / debugging. NOT sized for the full --run-all-tests matrix (it will starve in later phases by design). Use --small-test for a complete run-all. nodeA 50 / quorum 200 tokens; ranges far apart (600100+/700100+).
